next_step: Closed - lost to AWS managed endpoints. Revisit in H2 2025 if they re-evaluate cloud infra.
notes: Summary: multi-month evaluation, strong initial interest in Dedicated + Private for tenant isolation. Primary motivators: predictable latency, cost controls, ability to route between rules for AB tests.

Timeline: 2024-09-12 - Intro call (Maya + Liam). 2024-10-03 - Demo + infra deep-dive (fireflies ff_2024-10-03_3421). 2024-11-20 - Security review meeting with infra/security (ff_2024-11-20_7890). 2024-12-05 - POC kickoff (small batch, embeddings). 2024-12-12 - Procurement freeze flagged by CFO. 2025-01-08 - Final evaluation call; customer states they've elected to standardize on AWS managed endpoints for 2025.

Key quote from CTO: "We can get integrated infra billing, unified IAM, and a managed SLA from AWS that reduces our procurement friction — tough to argue vs building out a separate inference stack right now."

Technical notes: Arg. Lake ran latency-sensitive support-agent flows (95th p95 target < 80ms token gen), significant embedding indexing of product catalog (~200M vectors projected). They required KMS integration and US-only residency for PII-derived signals.

Security review: Redwood answered SOC2/KMS questions; security team preferred native cloud controls (CloudTrail + AWS KMS) and existing contracts with AWS discounts. Raised ticket SEC-2987 for clarifications; resolved but procurement still chose AWS due to contract term pricing.
POC outcome: Redwood Dedicated POC met latency and quality goals on small scale, cost estimate competitive but procurement model (reserved commit vs AWS managed consumption) was a blocker.

Loss reason: procurement & finance favored AWS managed endpoints (SageMaker/Bedrock) due to central purchasing agreements and existing enterprise discounts. No clear internal champion after eng lead exit. Budget freeze accelerated decision timeline.
Next recommended play: nurture for cross-sell when they evaluate cost-performance in 6-9 months; propose migration scorecard and a side-by-side cost/latency report. Book follow-up for Aug 2025.
Short action items: closed-lost in CRM; share short exit brief with GTM & Security; tag for account-based marketing (ABM) re-engage in 2025-08.
